+from pathlib import Path
+import json
+
+import duckdb
+import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
+import pandas as pd

+
+OUT = Path("out")

+con = duckdb.connect()

+    """
+    SELECT
+        year(crash_date) AS year,
+        count(*)::BIGINT AS crash_rows,
+        sum(number_of_motorist_killed)::BIGINT AS motorist_killed,
+        sum(number_of_motorist_injured)::BIGINT AS motorist_injured,
+        count(*) FILTER (
+            WHERE number_of_motorist_killed > 0 OR number_of_motorist_injured > 0
+        )::BIGINT AS motorist_casualty_crashes,
+        count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_motorist_killed IS NULL)::BIGINT AS killed_null,
+        count(*) FILTER (WHERE number_of_motorist_injured IS NULL)::BIGINT AS injured_null
+    FROM read_parquet(?)
+    WHERE crash_date >= CAST(? AS DATE) AND crash_date < CAST(? AS DATE)
+    GROUP BY year
+    ORDER BY year
+    """,
+    ["data/crashes.parquet", "2013-01-01", "2026-01-01"],
+).fetchdf()
+
+coverage = con.execute(
+    """
+    SELECT count(*)::BIGINT AS total,
+           count(*) FILTER (WHERE crash_date IS NULL)::BIGINT AS null_dates,
